title: Can prediabetes be reversed?
subtitle: Evidence-based answer to the common question: can prediabetes be reversed?
evidence_strength: Established evidence from randomized controlled trials and large cohort studies supports lifestyle modification as the primary means to reverse prediabetes and prevent type 2 diabetes. Pharmacologic interventions have moderate evidence for selected cases. Individual response varies, and long-term adherence is critical.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
